text:
Ojas Patel: Hey folks  first day! Laptop arrived but Im hitting two blockers: 1) MDM enrollment prompt keeps erroring out; 2) SSH to the jumpbox returns 'Permission denied (publickey)'. Also: where do I grab a badge if I swing by SF? Fun fact: I roast my own coffee and have a corgi named Bean who thinks hes a support engineer.
Rina Alvarez: Welcome Ojas!! :tada: Badge pickup at Lobby A (9-5) with photo ID. If remote we can mail a temporary sticker  DM me address. Im your onboarding buddy for the month.
Samira Khan: Hey Ojas  for MDM try reinstalling the CompanyMDM app and rebooting; sometimes the enrollment token expires and you need a fresh code. Also check that any VPN client is closed during enrollment.
devops-bot: SSH checklist: 1) upload public key to GitLab (Profile > SSH Keys); 2) run `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` (or the key you use); 3) ensure MDM shows device as "compliant" in the portal; 4) if still failing, paste `ssh -v` output (mask hostnames) and include the key filename.
mdm-bot: Enrollment steps: install CompanyMDM, open, sign in with @redwood.com, enter the emailed token. If you get an "Enrollment failed" error, request a new token from the IT portal and try again. Policies can take up to 10 minutes to apply. Reply "enrolled" when done.
Ojas Patel: Tried reinstall + reboot, still see enrollment error "token invalid": requested a new token and retrying. Added pubkey to GitLab.
Samira Khan: If token keeps failing DM me the exact error string and your OS version. For SSH, after you `ssh-add` run `ssh -v` and paste the last ~20 lines (mask hostnames) if it still denies. We can escalate to infra if it's a key mapping issue.
doorbot: FYI  visitor badge pickup sometimes queues at 9-10am; later afternoons are faster.
Ojas Patel: Enrolled successfully  MDM now shows compliant. Re-ran `ssh -v` and still getting permission denied, sending output to Samira in a DM. Thanks for the quick help everyone! Also: Bean (the corgi) says hi and promises coffee at the first in-person meetup :corgi::coffee:
